# Muhammad Properties — Property Dealers in Okara, Punjab, Pakistan

> A local real estate agency based on the GT Road (N-5) in Okara city, dealing in houses,
> residential plots, commercial shops and agricultural land across all three tehsils of
> Okara District: Okara, Depalpur and Renala Khurd. Operating since 2010.

## Services

- **Buying** — houses from 3 marla to 2 kanal, and residential plots in developed and
  under-development schemes across Okara District.
- **Selling** — free valuation for Okara District property, listing photography,
  WhatsApp and portal circulation, buyer screening.
- **Renting** — family houses, upper portions, offices and shops, with written tenancy
  agreements on stamp paper and support for tenant police verification.
- **Agricultural land** — cultivable land along the chak roads and canal distributaries;
  khasra numbers, watercourse rights, tube well and access road verified before purchase.
- **Commercial property** — shops, plazas and godowns on the GT Road, Katchery Bazar and
  the mandi belt.
- **Transfer and documentation** — fard malkiat from the Arazi Record Centre, mutation
  history checks, society or TMA NOC and dues clearance, sale deed, stamp duty and registry
  attendance, biometric verification.

## Areas covered

**Okara city:** Okara Cantt (Civil Area), Civil Lines, Company Bagh, Katchery Bazar,
Government Colony, Faisal Colony, Ghaziabad, Model Town Okara, Jawad Avenue, Canal View,
Canal Road and Canal Garden, Gulberg City, Al Kheer City, Al Rehman Town, Aziz Housing
Scheme, Saad City, Haider Town, Mehboob Town, Azhar Residencia, Railway Road, Depalpur Road,
Stadium Road and the GT Road (N-5) commercial belt.

**Okara District beyond the city:** Depalpur, Basirpur, Haveli Lakha, Hujra Shah Muqeem,
Renala Khurd (including Khalid Town and Green City), Satghara, and the surrounding chaks.

## Punjab land measurement

- 1 marla = 225 square feet = 25 square yards
- 20 marla = 1 kanal = 4,500 square feet
- 8 kanal = 1 acre

## About Okara District (context for the market)

- Okara city population: 533,693 (2023 census) — the 20th most populous city in Pakistan.
- Okara District population: 3,515,490 (2023 census), across three tehsils.
- The city sits on the N-5 National Highway (GT Road) and has been on the railway since 1892.
- Elevation about 105 m; irrigated by the Lower Bari Doab Canal, between the Ravi and Sutlej.
- Economy: one of Pakistan's largest potato-producing districts, plus maize and cotton;
  cotton mills; Sahiwal cattle and Nili-Ravi buffalo breeding; military dairy farms since 1913.

## Documents needed to buy property in Okara

CNIC of buyer and seller (NICOP for overseas Pakistanis); the original title document
(registry, allotment letter or transfer letter); fard malkiat / record of rights; society or
TMA no-objection certificate and dues clearance; approved building plan for constructed
property; recent utility bills clear of arrears.

Transfer costs include stamp duty, registration fee, capital value tax, TMA or district fees,
FBR advance tax under section 236K (buyer) and section 236C (seller) at filer and non-filer
rates, plus any society transfer fee. These rates change with each federal budget, so the
exact amount is confirmed at the time of transfer.
